name: Untouched by the Frost
source:
Play as Talih, who has left their home and everything they have ever known behind. It’s a harsh winter, with dangers lurking in the dark.

After being saved by an elven ranger and brought back from the brink, they must battle within themself whether to hang onto hope or to give into their own despair.

[from [url=https://greyenwright.itch.io/untouched-by-the-frost]itch.io[/url]]
